subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: per-instruction d16-d23 dump for k_v15_extend seed 2 (arm-O2)
body:
Requested dump saved at /tmp/n2hw-T01/v15ext.trace (not in tree). It is generated by a new debug mode: `n2a32_trace_dregs(1)` records d16-d23 before every instruction; build/run:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh   # builds the tree
  # then a diffrun built with the tree + --trace-kernel k_v15_extend --trace-seed 2 --trace-dregs --trace-out /tmp/v15ext.trace
Key samples from the dump (address 0x40039aXX, A32):
  after 0x39a9c vtst.32 q8,q9,q8   d16=0, d17=0x00000000ffffffff
  after 0x39aa0 vtst.32 q11,q9,q11 d22=0, d23=0x00000000ffffffff
  at 0x39aa8 vmovn.i32 d21,q8      d21=0x0000ffff00000000
  at 0x39aac vmovn.i16 d16,q10     pre d16=0x00ff000000000000
  d16 stays 0x00ff000000000000 through the vmov.u8 lane reads
  d17=0x00000000ffffffff
seed2 a=0x02020282. Final expected 84068594, got 8406859c. The d16=00ff000000000000 looks suspicious (only byte6 set) but may be correct for the compiler sequence; I cannot tell without your model. The dump has 100+ events; if you want a different register range or pre/post (currently pre-instruction) say so. Also note: the same kernel passes in thumb-O3v? It fails only arm-O2/thumb-O2; arm-O0/arm-O3v/thumb-O0/thumb-O3v pass. That may point at an instruction form only emitted at O2.
